Stage 5 · Java foundations

Interfaces: Pure Promises

“Can do X”, zero how. One device, MANY sockets.

⏱ 14 min🧠 No experience needed🧪 Interactive
Step 1

Fixed shape, any wiring

Drone + phone share Capturable.

🔌

Wall sockets. Shape fixed (method names); wiring differs per device. One class signs MANY sockets; many classes share ONE — polymorphism across UNRELATED families, zero blood shared.

Speaker promise
interface Speaker { void speak(); } // the promise
class Robot implements Speaker {    // signing it
  public void speak() { System.out.println("Beep!"); }
}
class Human implements Speaker {    // unrelated family!
  public void speak() { System.out.println("Hello!"); }
}
Speaker s = new Robot(); // promise-typed remote
s.speak(); // "Beep!"
All methods, or abstract. Implementations MUST be public. new Speaker()? A promise is not a thing!
